name: Mitake Yoriko
source:
A loyal vice president, who'll follow [url=/c64336]Arisu[/url] to the end of the earth.

The vice president of the student council, Yoriko is Arisu's right-hand woman, and closest friend. Although she perhaps reveres Arisu a little too much, and sticks by her side like a limpet, she's more than capable when it comes to her duties.

A little androphobic, she tries to steer clear of boys unless she has student council business with them. She's deeply wary of Arisu's new friend, [url=/c65997]Reiji[/url].

Yoriko is rarely seen without her beloved stun gun, though whether or not it actually works remains a mystery.

[Edited from [url=http://www.frontwing.jp/product/morokuro/en/#Character]English Official site[/url]]
